## Featured Engineering Projects

### 1. Islamic Smart Door (ISD)
- **Summary**: ESP32 smart access control system with 4-way access modalities and integrated Islamic daily utility features.
- **Hardware & Tech**: ESP32, PN532 NFC, Telegram Bot API, DF2301QG Voice Recognition, Kemenag API, SinricPro, Google Assistant, Next.js.
- **Key Highlights**:
  - 4-way access: PN532 NFC card, Telegram remote bot trigger, Web PIN interface, offline speech commands.
  - Automatic prayer times scheduling via Kemenag API with NTP sync and 20x4 LCD feedback.
  - SinricPro integration allowing Google Assistant smart home voice control.
  - Total hardware bill-of-materials kept under Rp 500.000.
  - 100/100 Google Lighthouse audit across all four categories.
- **Demo**: https://isd-overview.vercel.app/en
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mustafidh08/ISD-Overview-website

### 2. AgriSmart (Tim Al-Jazari)
- **Summary**: IoT & AI-powered hydroponic management system with automated pH/EC dosing and fail-safe trip protections.
- **Hardware & Tech**: ESP32, Analog pH/EC Probes, Peristaltic Dosing Pumps, MQTT, Telegram API, Next.js, Vercel.
- **Key Highlights**:
  - Dynamically configurable target parameters adapting to any hydroponic plant species.
  - Autonomous chemical balancing with safety trip handlers to prevent over-dosing.
  - Real-time sensor telemetry delivered to cloud dashboard and Telegram alerts.
  - Acquired by PT. AlKhwarizmi Kreatif Produktif for corporate research and internship development.
  - Awarded Certificate of Recognition for Technological Innovation (ID: 001/SERT/KHW/II/2026).
- **Demo**: https://agri-smart-kappa.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mustafidh08/agri-smart

### 3. BarFin (formerly KeuanganSyariah.id)
- **Summary**: Zero-installation, browser-based financial assistant referencing OJK Daftar Efek Syariah (DES) halal securities.
- **Tech**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, OJK DES Dataset, Vercel.
- **Key Highlights**:
  - Completely client-side execution ensuring 100% financial privacy on user devices.
  - Halal stock/investment verification against official OJK standards.
  - 99/100 Lighthouse Performance, 0.7s LCP, zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
- **Demo**: https://bar-fin-overview.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mustafidh08/BarFin-Overview

### 4. SLB Tunas Harapan School Website
- **Summary**: Accessible institutional portal for a special education school with headless CMS and security auditing.
- **Tech**: Next.js, Sanity.io, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel, PANDI DNS (.sch.id), OWASP Top 10:2025.
- **Key Highlights**:
  - Official .sch.id domain verification and DNS architecture via PANDI and Jagoan Hosting.
  - Sanity.io headless CMS integration for school administration announcements.
  - OWASP Top 10:2025 security assessment and remediation.
  - 100/100 Lighthouse Performance, Best Practices, and SEO.
- **Demo**: https://slbtunasharapan.sch.id/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/mustafidh08/Web-SLB-Tunas-Harapan-Samarinda
